items.statement: The submission declares a finite candidate-generation rule and reports coverage, deduplication and stopping criteria before or alongside results.
items.expected: A reproducible search rule and stopping/limitation statement are present.

items.statement: Every one of the six named carbocation models has an explicit status and validation record, and every advanced candidate retains parent identity.
items.expected: Six identifiable model records and candidate-level validation context are present.

items.statement: The independent analysis finds a chain-length-dependent change in relative stability or pathway preference rather than treating all six models as equivalent.
items.expected: The conclusion discriminates at least short versus long chain behavior using submitted evidence.

items.statement: The analysis tests more than one plausible pathway class and states what evidence supports or fails to support each class.
items.expected: Hypotheses include evidence and an assessment, including unresolved alternatives where applicable.
